Two departures in this prototype

1. Only Telangana opens below the national view. Its 588 blocks are scored on the frozen ruler and painted for real. Every other State/UT hovers normally — whole-state highlight, State-level tooltip — but is not selectable, because no block outside Telangana has been scored. One worked State/UT demonstrates the workflow.

2. Detailed Analysis is a stub. The action and the state it carries are real, including which driver metric was selected; the destination only displays that state.

Context and Evidence carries no basin or river map overlay and no basin context at State/UT scope; the card and the method note say why.
